card.title: PS5 WiFi module standby power short circuit and pad inspection

source.title: PS5 WiFi module and standby power short check locations

claims.statement: Shorts in the WiFi area capacitors can cause no power issues.
claims.evidence: Annotation pointing to capacitors with text 'Check capacitors for shorts. It can cause no power issues'

claims.statement: Ripped pads in the WiFi module area should be checked.
claims.evidence: Annotation pointing to connector pads with text 'Check for ripped pads'

cautions: Check for ripped pads on the WiFi module connector area.
card.caveats: The image does not provide specific voltage or resistance values for the capacitors.
